title: Regional SMP
description: A simple no rules Minecraft SMP to find friends and play together!
body:
### Regional SMP

A simple minecraft server without any plot-twist (or you could say Vanilla! With.. a few mod).

This server is made for you who dosent have any friends or you just wanna play!

Play it now With Vanilla minecraft!


<details>
<summary>FAQ</summary>

Q: What minecraft version should i use to join?
A: 1.21.11 is the current available version for the server.

Q: Why cant i join the server on weekday?
A: This server use Aternos so i only open the server on Weekends (so my computer didnt overheat).

Q: The server is LAGGY.
A: The server use Aternos so if its laggy im sorry but i currently trying to fix it, but if you still laggy try checking your ping.

</details>
